context: Two managers plan an e-commerce launch meeting
purpose: Teach: 小売/通販/入社/デバイス/インテリア/店内/応答/受け取っ

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 来月の通販サイト立ち上げの件、社内会議の日程を決めたいんだけど。
lines.en: About next month's online shopping site launch, I want to set the internal meeting date.
lines.style: Calm middle-aged male manager, measured pace, slightly formal but collegial workplace tone.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: はい、小売部門のメンバーも呼びますか？特に店内側の意見も聞いておきたいので。
lines.en: Yes, should we call the retail division members too? I'd like to hear the in-store side's opinions especially.
lines.style: Composed female office worker in her thirties, polite keigo, brisk professional cadence.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: そうだね。店内のディスプレイとインテリアを連動させる案もあるから、装飾担当も入れよう。
lines.en: Right. There's a plan to link in-store displays with interior design, so let's include the decoration person too.
lines.style: Calm middle-aged male manager, thoughtful pauses, mild affirmative nodding tone.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 承知しました。あと、新しい入社の田中さんにモバイルデバイスのテストを任せてもいいでしょうか。
lines.en: Understood. Also, can we entrust the newly joined Tanaka-san with the mobile device testing?
lines.style: Polite female professional, clear enunciation, deferential question intonation.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: いいね。彼は若いからアプリの応答速度とかも敏感に気づいてくれそうだ。
lines.en: Good idea. He's young, so he'll probably notice things like app response speed sensitively.
lines.style: Calm male manager, warmer tone, slight chuckle, approving cadence.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 先ほど物流から見積もりのメールを受け取ったので、後で転送しますね。
lines.en: I received a quote email from logistics earlier, so I'll forward it to you later.
lines.style: Efficient female office worker, businesslike, smooth report-style delivery.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 助かるよ。じゃあ金曜の三時に会議室を押さえておいてくれる？
lines.en: That helps. So, can you reserve the meeting room for Friday at three?
lines.style: Calm male manager, friendly closing tone, gentle request inflection.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: かしこまりました。すぐに予約します。
lines.en: Certainly. I'll book it right away.
lines.style: Crisp polite female reply, short and decisive, professional closing.
